paragraphs: First Horizon Corporation is a Tennessee corporation. We incorporated in 1968, and are headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee. We are registered as a bank holding company and have elected to be treated as a financial holding company. Our common stock is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "FHN." At December 31, 2025, we had total consolidated assets of $84 billion.

We provide commercial, private banking, consumer, small business, wealth and trust management, retail brokerage, capital markets, fixed income, and mortgage banking services principally through our wholly-owned subsidiary, First Horizon Bank. Founded in 1864 as First National Bank of Memphis, the Bank is a Tennessee banking corporation headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee. At December 31, 2025, the Bank had $84 billion in total assets, $68 billion in total deposits, and $64 billion in total loans (including
certain leases, before considering the allowance for loan and lease losses).

In addition to the Bank, as of December 31, 2025, First Horizon's consolidated operating subsidiaries include, but are not limited to: two subsidiaries which are registered with the SEC as investment advisors; two subsidiaries which are registered with the SEC as broker-dealers; and three subsidiaries which are licensed as insurance agencies.

At December 31, 2025, First Horizon had over 450 business locations in 23 U.S. states, excluding off-premises ATMs. Most of those locations (412) were banking centers located in southern states, including Tennessee (137), North Carolina (78), Florida (74), and Louisiana (55).

Lending is a major source of revenue for us, and loans are our largest asset type. Table 1.1 shows our total loans (including certain leases) at year-end 2025, along with some details regarding the composition of our loans. Most of our loans are commercial.

As shown in Table 1.1, our loans are broken into two major types: commercial and consumer. Each type is broken into portfolios. Our three major portfolios are: traditional, unsecured commercial, financial and industrial ("C&I") loans; secured commercial real estate ("CRE") loans; and secured consumer real estate loans. A fourth portfolio consists of consumer credit card and other consumer debt.

We are subject to intense competition for clients, and the nature of that competition is changing. Our competitors include national, state, and non-US banks, savings and loan associations, credit unions, consumer finance companies, trust companies, investment counseling firms, money market and other mutual funds, insurance companies and agencies, securities firms, mortgage banking companies, hedge funds, and other financial services companies that serve in our markets. The emergence of non-traditional, disruptive service providers (see Industry Disruption within this Item 1A beginning on page 22) has intensified the competitive environment.

Some competitors are traditional banks, subject to the same regulatory framework as we are, while others are not banks and in many cases experience a significantly different or reduced degree of regulation.

paragraphs: First Horizon Corporation 是一家田納西州公司。我們於 1968 年成立，總部設於田納西州孟菲斯。我們已登記為銀行控股公司，並選擇以財務控股公司方式進行營運。本公司普通股於紐約證券交易所上市，代碼為 "FHN"。於 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司合併總資產為 840 億美元。

我們提供商業銀行、私人銀行、消費金融、小型企業、財富管理與信託服務、零售證券經紀、資本市場、固定收益及房貸銀行服務，主要透過我們的 wholly-owned 子公司 First Horizon Bank 提供。First Horizon Bank 於 1864 年成立，原為孟菲斯第一國家銀行，為一家田納西州銀行公司，總部設於田納西州孟菲斯。於 2025 年 12 月 31 日，該銀行總資產為 840 億美元，總存款為 680 億美元，總貸款為 640 億美元（包含
某些租賃，扣除貸款及租賃損失準備金後的數字）。
除了該銀行之外，於 2025 年 12 月 31 日，First Horizon 的合併營運子公司包括，但不僅限於：兩家已向 SEC 登記為投資顧問的子公司；兩家已向 SEC 登記為證券經紀商的子公司；以及三家已取得保險經紀商許可的子公司。
於 2025 年 12 月 31 日，First Horizon 在美國 23 個州擁有超過 450 個營業據點（不含離營區 ATM）。其中大多數據點（412 個）為銀行中心，位於南部各州，包括田納西州（137 個）、北卡羅來納州（78 個）、佛羅裏達州（74 個）及路易斯安那州（55 個）。
貸款為我們的主要收入來源，貸款為我們最大的資產類別。表 1.1 顯示我們於 2025 年底的總貸款（包含某些租賃），以及一些關於貸款組成的細節。我們的大多數貸款為商業貸款。
如表 1.1 所示，我們的貸款分為兩大類型：商業貸款與消費貸款。每類型再分為不同組合。我們的三大貸款組合為：傳統貸款、無擔保商業貸款、財務與工業（"C&I"）貸款；有擔保商業不動產（"CRE"）貸款；以及有擔保消費不動產貸款。第四類組合為消費信用卡及其他消費貸款。
